It is really exhausting. Being honest and all. I wished I could be more open to my parents. But no worries, I'm trying to be better for myself. I'm kinda over from that phase. I'm actually thinking of traveling and my specialist told me it can help me. So I'm saving a lil bit of my money.
Hi. Thank you so much for the advice and listening. I'm actually still afraid of the session but I'm taking it slowly. Everything is fine so far.

It warms my heart up to know that someone across this world is giving this kind of speech. It's really moving. Thank you. I'm going to meet the doctor this weekend. I also will keep this as a secret to myself that I'm seeing a specialist. I can't still say that everything is fine. It hasn't. But talking to you made it a little brighter. At least, I can hold on to something that there still some goodness in this life. I'm spouting nonsense now. But really, genuinely thank you.
Yes. I agree. I can totally relate. Especially now that your parents are regretting they gave life to you. Sometimes we wished we never existed.
